title: C: Variadic Functions
description: Write a variadic function that sums an arbitrary number of integers using stdarg.h.

steps.title: Variadic Sum
steps.description: Write a function `int sum(int count, ...)` that takes a count followed by that many integers, and returns their sum. Call with 5 numbers (10, 20, 30, 40, 50) and print the result.
